NoteData Preparation

The sub-district boundary of Kepulauan Bangka Belitung is getting by filtering latest whole indonesia shapefile (raw). After checking number of Kabupaten/Kota, it matches with latest official data. In this case, although the number of region is 393 which is higher than the hands-on material given, the following exercise will continue by using this 393 regions data.

kbb_sf <- kbb %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_zm(drop = TRUE, what = "ZM") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32748)
kbb_owin <- as.owin(kbb_sf)
kbb_owin
window: polygonal boundary
enclosing rectangle: [512066.8, 930756.9] x [9579205, 9834915] units
class(kbb_owin)
[1] "owin"

3.2 Importing and Preparing Forest Fire data

fire_raw <- read_csv("hands-on_ex3_data/modis_2024_Indonesia.csv")
fire_sf <- fire_raw %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32748)
NoteData used

latest 2024 data is used in this exercise.

fire_sf <- fire_sf %>% 
  mutate(DayofYear = yday(acq_date)) %>%
  mutate(Month_num = month(acq_date)) %>%
  mutate(Month_fac = month(acq_date, 
                           label = TRUE, 
                           abbr = FALSE))

3.3 Visualising the Fire Points

tm_shape(kbb_sf)+
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(fire_sf) +
  tm_dots() +
  tm_title("Overall plot") + 
  tm_credits("Forest Fires in Kepulauan Bangka Belitung")
NotePlot Title

tm_credit() is initially used as credit introduction, since tmap does not have function like sub-title, here it is used just for web display.

tm_shape(kbb_sf)+
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(fire_sf) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.1) +
tm_facets(by="Month_fac", 
            free.coords=FALSE, 
            drop.units = TRUE) + 
  tm_title("Monthly geographic distribution of forest fires")

3.4 Computing STKDE by Month

3.7 Spatio-temporal Point Patterns Analysis: stpp methods

coords <- st_coordinates(fire_sf)

fire_df <- data.frame(
  x = coords[, 1],  
  y = coords[, 2],
  t = fire_sf$`DayofYear`)

fire_stpp <- as.3dpoints(fire_df)
class(fire_stpp)
[1] "stpp"
plot(fire_stpp)
kbb_stik <- STIKhat(fire_stpp)

plotK(kbb_stik)
NoteWarning on duplicated spatial points

STIKhat() returns a warning indicating duplicated spatial points. A check of the input data found no duplicated space-time observations (x, y, t), while 12 observations share spatial coordinates (x, y) with another observation but occur at different times. Therefore, these observations are retained for the space-time analysis.
